description: The problems of one entity's options, as DefinitionDocument.Options gives them: each case is one Entity node of a graph definition (its key, domain, name when it has one, and options) and the problems the server answers for it, in order: code, option (the option the problem is about) and message (messageStartsWith where the tail is the regular expression engine's own words). Each problem is on that node (nodeId), about its option (inputId option:<option>, portId null); options that are not an object have no case, as the node's own Options field says so. A case marked local is one the panel finds itself (optionProblems), in the same words. Consumed by tests/Runtime (EntityStoreTests) and by the frontend's in-memory backend and optionProblems tests.
